title: BGP: Dissect BFD Discriminator path attribute (RFC 9026)
description:
Summary:

Implements dissection of the BGP BFD Discriminator path attribute (Type 38) as specified in RFC 9026 ("Multicast VPN Fast Upstream Failover").

Changes:

\- Dissect the BFD Mode (1 octet) and BFD Discriminator (4 octets) fields.

\- Append decoded Mode and Discriminator values to the path attribute tree item.

\- Parse Optional TLVs including Source IP Address (Type 1) for IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

\- Register all header fields under bgp.update.path_attribute.bfd\_\* and bgp.bfd_discriminator.tlv.\*.

\- Add boundary checks and expert info for truncated or invalid length fields.

commits_data.message:
BGP: Dissect BFD Discriminator path attribute (RFC 9026)

RFC 9026 specifies the BFD Discriminator path attribute (Type 38) used to signal BFD session information for tracking P-tunnel status.

Implement dissection of:

- BFD Mode (1 octet) and BFD Discriminator (4 octets).

- Optional TLVs including Source IP Address (Type 1, IPv4/IPv6).

- Length bounds and error reporting for malformed/truncated attributes.
